identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][tooling] Make Unity editor liveness and batch proof reliable for deployed observatory

values.summary: Implemented and independently reviewed a fail-closed Unity editor-liveness proof route with exact process evidence, bounded semantic idle detection, approved staging, and focused selector coverage.
actual_changes: Select and print open_editor, fresh_batch, or skipped_fail_closed before Unity work.
Use repository-installed adl process status against exact PID metadata and fail closed on ambiguous project locks.
Stage only under /Volumes/FastWork or issue-local .adl storage and pass the owner binary a repository-relative packet reference.
Reset liveness only on import, compile, validation, or terminal markers; classify readonly text in temporal context.
Route generic external startup-classifier outcomes without embedding #5332 signatures or thresholds.
Register one focused Unity editor-liveness validation lane and add no-Unity regression coverage plus an operator runbook.
Select and print open_editor, fresh_batch, or skipped_fail_closed before Unity work.
Validate repository owner-binary provenance and permission-safe process-status JSON before trusting liveness.
Bound fresh-batch and editor-mediated execution by monotonic semantic progress without imposing an arbitrary total runtime ceiling.
Isolate staged projects, logs, and editor-result evidence under approved roots.
Register a focused Unity editor-liveness lane without downgrading full soak or smoke validation.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove safe mode selection, exact process-status routing, relative packet invocation, semantic progress, contextual readonly handling, idle/crash/licensing/external outcomes, and cleanup without launching Unity; coupled contract, selector, shell syntax, JSON, and diff checks also passed.
actual_validation.evidence_ref: Local focused proof passed: unit PASS, v0.91.6 contract guardrails PASS, validation selector PASS, four wrapper syntax checks PASS, JSON parsing PASS, and git diff --check PASS.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove one real safe-mode Unity attempt records exact progress and terminal truth without an arbitrary total ceiling.
actual_validation.evidence_ref: .csdlc/evidence/4741/live-staged-proof.json records fresh_batch on Unity 6000.5.1f1, readonly followed by import and compilation progress, semantic fingerprint 1:1:1:0, and expected fail-closed exit 124 terminal_outcome=semantic_progress_idle after 300 idle seconds. Unity validation was not reached and is not claimed.
